{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Load the provided scenario or an empty scenario in the provided world.

|s1= [[load3DENScenario]] scenarioOrWorld

|p1= scenarioOrWorld: [[String]] - scenario name or world name

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] on success, [[false]] otherwise

|x1= <sqf>load3DENScenario "MyMission.VR";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>load3DENScenario "Stratis";</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>
//For a scenario located at ...\Arma 3 - Other Profiles\<PROFILENAME>\missions\subfolder\myMission.VR
//full path needs to be provided without leading \
load3DENScenario "missions\subfolder\myMission.VR";
</sqf>

|seealso= [[is3DENPreview]]
}}
